title: JourneyLite Virtual Support Group: 8/29/2023 12:30pm
author: DrCurry
bodyHtml:
Tuesday August 29, 2023
12:30 pm-1:30 pm
Topic: Building Healthy Habits

Go to the link below on your smart phone or PC to join the virtual meeting.

Habits are the foundation of our daily lives! From brushing our teeth to watching our favorite TV show in the evenings, they run our day. Creating new habits (and breaking old ones) can feel like an impossible task. However, when we understand the inside facts about building habits, it can become much easier. Join Devon Price, RD/LD in going down the rabbit hole that is all things habits and learn the 4 step process to changing them!

rsvp: rd@curryweightloss.com
